summary: Jaguar Health filed an 8-K disclosing privately negotiated exchange agreements dated September 25, 2026 with Streeterville Capital, LLC, holder of the 2021 secured promissory note originally issued at $6,220,812.50. Jaguar issued 481,584 common shares in exchange for a $3,400,000 reduction of the note balance, implying roughly $7.06 per share, exempt under Section 3(a)(9). Streeterville is a lender, not a board-advised counterparty; no recommendation or advisor named. Post-transaction shares outstanding were approximately 1,945,542, meaning the exchange shares represent roughly 25% dilution. Watch the remaining note balance and further exchanges.
